---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The problem**

What are you trying to do that the viewer makes hard or impossible today?

**The idea**

What you would like it to do instead.

**Alternatives**

Other approaches you considered, or how you work around this now.

**Scope check**

OpenLiDARViewer is a viewer, not a full GIS or survey-grade processing suite.
See the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Aurtechmx/openlidarviewer/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
for what has shipped and
[limitations](https://github.com/Aurtechmx/openlidarviewer/blob/main/docs/limitations.md)
for what is out of scope.

**Anything else**

Mockups, links, or examples that make the idea concrete.
